_doc: Engine verification suites. Read by scripts/verify/plan.py (CI planning, change detection) and scripts/verify/run.sh (local and CI runs). Fields: cargo = the cargo target selection that builds the suite; test = optional exact test name inside that binary; platforms = where each tier runs it (platform-independent logic runs on linux only); roots = workspace packages whose dependency closure decides whether a change can affect the suite; own = files that only affect this suite (a change confined to them selects just this suite). skip = case-id globs left out of a tier on a platform (CAP_VERIFY_SKIP), to keep the FAST tier within its time budget; the FULL tier runs them.

suites.name: verify-self
suites.about: marker codecs, reference timeline model, oracle and report self-tests

suites.name: export
suites.about: every exported frame against the reference model (MP4, GIF, both decoders on macOS)

suites.name: playback
suites.about: offline-driven editor playback frames against the reference model

suites.name: seek
suites.about: random, keyframe and scrub seeks against the reference model

suites.name: audio
suites.about: export and offline playback audio against sample-accurate markers (mic, system audio, cuts, speeds, mute, volume, A/V offset)

suites.name: editing
suites.about: random edit sequences (split, delete, speed, trim, reorder, transitions) exported and checked frame by frame against the reference model

suites.name: captions
suites.about: fake-transcriber captions: caption segments and rendered captions on the right frames

suites.name: decoder-model-ffmpeg
suites.about: model-based fuzzing of the FFmpeg decoder's request decisions on scripted media

suites.name: decoder-model-avf
suites.about: model-based fuzzing of the AVAssetReader decoder's request decisions on scripted media

suites.name: native-rendering
suites.about: native macOS rendering regressions (IOSurface source lifetime in the YUV converter)
